name: Extension
summary: Whether the horse can make black pigment at all. E lets black through; e/e removes it entirely, leaving only red - a chestnut - on which every gene that merely moves black pigment is invisible.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: Black pigment is produced normally. Whether it is visible is agouti's business.

phenotypes.name: Chestnut
phenotypes.description: No black pigment anywhere - the horse is red, from liver to flaxen chestnut, and every gene that only moves black pigment is invisible on it.
